title: metadata-admin TranslationPreview: add the `positions` and `permissions` groups objectstack 47af3dde42 added to TranslationDataSchema — app-shell fails to type-check at the next pin, and objectstack's Console Pin Gate is red
body:
Filing gate ①: main red in objectstack, reproduced in its hourly full battery. Filed by the objectstack triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat. One small PR, then objectstack moves its console pin past it (objectstack's own card names this one as its blocker).

## Measured

- objectstack `CI` schedule run 40136758584, 2026-10-24 22:01Z, on `main` `47af3dde42`: job `Console Pin Gate` (120999879793) fails at "Build the Console SPA at the pinned objectui SHA". It builds objectui `2958f17e9c6a` against objectstack's own spec:
  ```
  src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx(99,3): error TS1360: Type '{ objects: …; picklists: …; apps: …; … 7 more …; settingsCommon: { …; }; }' does not satisfy the expected type 'Record<"positions" | "permissions" | "apps" | "objects" | "dashboards" | "pages" | "messages" | "picklists" | "globalActions" | "datasets" | "flows" | "metadataForms" | "settingsCommon", Omit<…>>'.
    … is missing the following properties from type 'Record<…>': positions, permissions
  ```
- **Cause:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#25701 (`47af3dde42`, the change for objectstack-ai/objectstack#25652) added the `positions` and `permissions` groups to `TranslationDataSchema`. `TranslationPreview.tsx` derives `TranslationGroup` from that schema's shape (`:72`), and `CATEGORY_DEFS` must list every group (`:99`, `satisfies Record<TranslationGroup, …>`).
- The gate passed on the previous schedule run (40132362906 on `4bcc4df649`). It runs on the schedule only, so the merge did not see it.

## Wanted

- Two `CATEGORY_DEFS` rows, `positions` and `permissions`, each with a label key `engine.translationPreview.category.positions` / `…permissions` and an icon. Add the two keys to every locale pack.
- The preview then counts and samples those groups like the others.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` passes against an objectstack `packages/spec` at `47af3dde42` or later. objectui builds `@objectstack/*` from its `.objectstack-sha`, so that pin must be at or past `47af3dde42`: move it in the same PR if it is behind, and say so.
- `check:i18n-keys` is green with the two new keys.

## Dedupe

objectui and objectstack issues created since 2026-10-24T21:00Z were read by title: objectstack-ai/objectui#13477 (the label render of the same change, a different defect) is the only neighbour. **New.**
